title: Error: xDrip looses connection often for up to 1hr, error in the logs: "No Transmitter mac address"
symptom: Since the last nightlies (from January) xDrip has issues again in connecting the transmitter. It has downtimes of over an hour in between until it is able to reconnect. The error message shown in the logs is "No transmitter mac address" followed by a note that location permission is missing. xDrip has the location permission enabled.
cause: The error messages for location services are for the smart watch. The user was not using the smart watch as a collector, but the watch was causing the location permission errors.
fix: Grant xDrip on the watch location permissions, even though the watch is not used as a collector. The user also changed several settings: unchecked Samsung Workarounds, unchecked minimize scanning, checked allow OB1 disconnect, and granted location permissions on the watch.
evidence_quote: The error messages for location services you are seeing are for your smart watch. If you are not using your smart watch as a collector I would disable that setting from the smart watch.
